newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner's Cunard sells cruise ship for $23 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner's Cunard sells cruise ship for $23 mln.

text.p: Cunard Line, a subsidiary of Norway's Kvaerner ASA, said on Wednesday it had sold the Cunard Countess cruise ship for $23 million to Indonesia's Awani Cruise Line.
The sale was part of the group's plans to reposition as the world's foremost luxury cruise line, Cunard said in a statement.
Cunard Countess will complete its next few cruises before being withdrawn from service on October 26.

Cunard said it would concentrate activities on the growing luxury end of the market and will focus more on its top-rated ships the Royal Viking Sun, the Queen Elizabeth 2, the Vistafjord and the Sea Goddess I and II.
